unwritten_consumer_rules.rule: Bundle must have a nonempty records array of objects; each record needs object-valued data; records sorted by source_sequence (default 0) and grouped by record_type string
When any execution evidence is present exactly one execution_envelope and one execution_result are required

Retained Replay fields (records, links, commitments, producer_profiles, status, import_reports, semantics) and selected metadata must equal Replay's own re-derivation or export refuses; legacy CP 2ea9528e: compatible_control_plane_revisions removed from the expected value before comparing
Producer-contract is trusted only when metadata.moltbot_producer_contract is a dict and not legacy; source_asserted revision labelled revision_status 'source_asserted'
Control Plane vs executor attempt namespaces: an attempt id must be in exactly one namespace (executor vs attributed CP) else ExportError

Result status is normalised through ODES-side vocabularies: decision result (allow/hold/deny families) and observed state (applied/partial/absent/unknown families) are mapped by hard-coded string sets, not by a shared enum
Exact decision/proposal action binding; proposal-less decisions require digest-bound Manifest; derivation is refused; risk_metadata must be an object
Replay package must be importable in the environment; not declared in pyproject.toml dependencies (only jsonschema>=4.21)
Consumer-side assumptions documented as the origin of F-20..F-22 (Replay encoded unwritten producer shapes); ODES design doc states the rule 'written down in neither place'
